curated.instructions: None found: neither LEGO's site nor lego.brickinstructions.com has this set's book, so the functions are inferred from the four models, by Takeshi Takahashi. The set builds four engines, each a model of its own, each of whose functions names its model.

functions.does: 2-cycle engine: turning the hand wheel, the 24 tooth gear beside the engine with a pin for a handle, turns the crankshaft through a rubber band, about 2.9 times as fast, so its one piston runs up and down.
functions.source: inferred: the rubber band runs from the belt wheels on the hand wheel's axle to a bush on the crankshaft

functions.does: Boxer engine: turning the crank, the 40 tooth gear on the end of the crankshaft, with a pin for a handle, turns the crankshaft, so its six pistons run in and out, three each side.
functions.source: inferred: the crankshaft is built of 24 tooth gears joined by axles off their middles

functions.does: Inline engine: pins on the camshaft's gears lift the three push rods in turn, and each rod tips its valve's rocker on the axle across the top of the cylinders; between pins, each rod drops back onto the plate it stands through, and its rocker onto the rod, or the studs below.
functions.source: inferred: the push rods stand on the camshaft's pins, under the rockers; KineBrick keeps each resting on what's highest under it, as gravity would

functions.does: Inline engine: turning the crank, the 40 tooth gear on the end of the crankshaft, with a pin for a handle, turns the crankshaft, so its three pistons run up and down.
functions.source: inferred: the crankshaft is built of 24 tooth gears joined by axles off their middles

functions.does: Inline engine: as the crankshaft turns, rubber bands from its belt wheels turn the fan and the distributor's axle.
functions.source: inferred: the two rubber bands run from the crankshaft's belt wheels to bushes on the fan's axle pin and the distributor's axle

functions.does: Inline engine: the crankshaft's four 24 tooth gears turn the camshaft's four beside them, at the same speed.
functions.source: inferred: the camshaft's gears sit beside the crankshaft's, in the hole beside its; the model had the camshaft 2 LDU off that hole, 62 LDU from the crankshaft, so the gears missed, which models/ corrects

functions.does: Inline engine: pins on the camshaft's gears lift the three push rods in turn, and each rod tips its valve's rocker on the axle across the top of the cylinders; between pins, each rod drops back onto the plate it stands through, and its rocker onto the rod, or the studs below.
functions.source: inferred: the push rods stand on the camshaft's pins, under the rockers; KineBrick keeps each resting on what's highest under it, as gravity would

functions.does: V-6 engine: turning the crank, the 40 tooth gear on the end of the crankshaft, with a pin for a handle, turns the crankshaft, so its six pistons run in and out of the two cylinder banks, which stay where they are: an axle across their tops and the engine block hold them in a V.
functions.source: book (Peeron's scans, filed as 8858-2): V-6 steps 1-5 (the crankshaft, its connecting rods, and the 1 x 4 Technic bricks each bank hangs from, on 12 long axles), 9-14 (the banks) and 17 (both swung up to meet at the top)

functions.does: V-6 engine: as the crankshaft turns, rubber bands from its belt wheels turn the fan and the long axle along the engine's side.
functions.source: inferred: the two rubber bands run from the crankshaft's belt wheels to bushes on the fan's axle pin and the side axle

questions.question: What holds the boxer and inline engines' round cap (a 2 x 2 round brick on an axle) to the block: does the bush under it fit between four studs?
